intro.uz: Bu — Nilufarning dugonasiga yozgan xati. Oʻqishdan oldin: taklifnomada qanday maʼlumotlar boʻladi?

paragraphs.en: Hi Aziza, how are you? I have good news. My birthday is on Saturday, 20 May, and I would like to invite you to my party!
paragraphs.uz: Salom, Aziza! Qalaysan? Menda yaxshi xabar bor. Mening tugʻilgan kunim 20-may, shanba kuni, va seni bazmimga taklif qilmoqchiman!

paragraphs.en: The party is at our house in Yunusobod. It starts at 4 o'clock in the afternoon and finishes at 8. Our address is 12 Lola Street.
paragraphs.uz: Bazm Yunusoboddagi uyimizda boʻladi. U tushdan keyin soat 4 da boshlanib, 8 da tugaydi. Manzilimiz: Lola koʻchasi, 12-uy.

paragraphs.en: There is a big birthday cake and plov for everyone. We can play games and dance in the garden. My cousin Bekzod can play the guitar.
paragraphs.uz: Hamma uchun katta tugʻilgan kun torti va palov boʻladi. Biz bogʻda oʻyinlar oʻynashimiz va raqsga tushishimiz mumkin. Amakivachcham Bekzod gitara chala oladi.

paragraphs.en: Please don't bring a big present. A card is fine! Can you come? Please write back by Thursday. Love, Nilufar
paragraphs.uz: Iltimos, katta sovgʻa olib kelma. Bitta otkritka ham yetarli! Kela olasanmi? Iltimos, payshanbagacha javob yoz. Mehr bilan, Nilufar

grammar.example: I would like to invite you to my party!
My birthday is on Saturday, 20 May

explain.uz: «My birthday is on Saturday, 20 May». Payshanba — javob berish muddati, 12 — uy raqami.

questions.statement: The party is at a cafe.

explain.uz: Bazm uyda boʻladi: «The party is at our house in Yunusobod.»

questions.prompt: What time does the party start?

explain.uz: «It starts at 4… and finishes at 8.» Soat 8 da bazm tugaydi.

questions.statement: There is a cake at the party.

explain.uz: «There is a big birthday cake and plov for everyone.»
«My cousin Bekzod can play the guitar.»

questions.statement: Aziza must bring a big present.

explain.uz: Nilufar yozadi: «Please don’t bring a big present. A card is fine!»
